notes: NVK 6204-2RS, two black recessed rubber seals; orange E25B12 seal variant. One analytic convex 48-sided prism with vertices on the nominal OD47 circle, 0.6 mm bevel rings at both ends; collision deliberately fills the ID20 visual bore. A 48-sided prism requires at least 96 vertices (192 with both bevel rings), which cannot meet the universal 64-vertex/file rule. prop_lib therefore divides that same convex solid into exact convex subpieces without changing its union or enlarging its diameter. This is the closest faithful validator-compatible choice. Metres, Z up, front -X, bottom-centre origin, applied transforms and a shared prop frame. Triangulated visual OBJ with normals, 30-degree smoothing, nonoverlapping 66-degree Smart UVs. Albedo: CPU Cycles 64-sample DIFFUSE COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), RGB8 sRGB, no direct light or highlights. Full Principled PBR and marking images packed in source.blend. Preview: 1024 square, CPU Cycles 64, neutral grey, three lights, front-left above. Collision coordinates retain 12 decimal places in metres. Simulation may vary instance colour by 0.97-1.03. Suggested worktable position [0.400, 0, 0.800] m; positioning and reachable grasp poses are left to the scene, not baked into these local meshes.  Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 10 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
